name: Geeked By MKX - 2g Live Resin Disposable - Jack The Ripper - Sativa
description:
After months of development, we’ve perfected our 2-gram Live Resin Disposable, engineered to deliver a true full-spectrum experience with unmatched potency and flavor. Every detail, from airflow to power tuning, has been optimized for smooth and consistent draws from start to finish. 
Crafted with premium 100% live resin sourced from local small-batch growers, available in Indica, Sativa, and Hybrid varieties, capturing rich terpenes and authentic full-spectrum quality in every hit.
Instructions
1. Power On/Off: Press the button on the bottom of the device 5 times to turn on or off.
2. Preheat: Press the button 2 times to activate preheat mode.
3. Adjust Voltage: Press the button 3 times to switch heat settings.
o Red VPU icon: High Voltage
o Blue VPU icon: Low Voltage
